			SnapshotID:            item.Status.SnapshotID,
		})
	}

}

func (m *connectionManager) waitForConnectedState(stateChannel <-chan connectionstate.State) error {
	log.Debug().Msg("waiting for connected state")
	for {
		select {
		case state, more := <-stateChannel:
			if !more {
				return ErrConnectionFailed
			}

			switch state {
			case connectionstate.Connected:
				log.Debug().Msg("Connected started event received")
				if m.acknowledge != nil {
					go m.acknowledge()
				}
				m.onStateChanged(state)
				m.eventBus.SubscribeAsync(sleep.AppTopicSleepNotification, m.handleSleepEvent)
				return nil
			default:
				m.onStateChanged(state)
			}
		case <-m.currentCtx().Done():
			return m.currentCtx().Err()
		}
	}
}

func (m *connectionManager) handleSleepEvent(e sleep.Event) {
	switch e {
	case sleep.EventSleep:
		log.Info().Msg("Got sleep notification during live vpn session")
	case sleep.EventWakeup:
		log.Info().Msg("Got wake-up from sleep notification - checking if need to reconnect")

		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 200*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
		if err := m.CheckChannel(ctx); err != nil {
			log.Info().Msgf("Channel dead - reconnecting: %s", err)
			m.reconnect()
		} else {
			log.Info().Msg("Channel still alive - no need to reconnect")
		}
	}
}

		".ddev/data",
	}
	for _, d := range dirs {
		dirPath := filepath.Join(base, d)

	}

}

	amount += consensus.BlockSubsidy(blockHeight)
	unlockHeight := blockHeight + consensus.CoinbasePendingBlockNumber

	var script []byte
	if accountManager == nil {
		script, err = vmutil.CoinbaseProgram(nil, 0, unlockHeight)

		script, err = accountManager.GetCoinbaseControlProgram(unlockHeight)

	if err != nil {
		return

	if err != nil {
		return
	}

		TxData: *txData,
		Tx:     legacy.MapTx(txData),
	}
	return
}

+func (b *Broker) retry(f func() error, maxRetry int, retryMilliseconds int) bool {
+	success := false
+	for attempt := 1; attempt <= maxRetry; attempt++ {
+		err := f()
+		if err != nil {

+			continue
+		}
+		success = true
+		break
+	}
+	return success

func NewTCPConn(addr Address) (conn *TCPConn, err error) {
	netAddr := addr.NetworkAddress()
	for i := 1; i <= MaxRetryConnect; i++ {
		var c net.Conn
		c, err = net.Dial("tcp", netAddr)
		if err == nil {
			conn = &TCPConn{
				endpoint: addr,
				conn:     c,
			}
			return
		}
		if i < MaxRetryConnect {

		}
	}
	if err == nil {

	}
	return

		ipMatch := nameserver.FindStringSubmatch(scanner.Text())

			}

	}

		return false
	}
	return true
}

func (a *Agent) GenerateCSR(spiffeID *url.URL) ([]byte, error) {
	a.Config.Logger.Log("msg", "Generating a CSR for %s", spiffeID.String())

	uriSANs, err := uri.MarshalUriSANs([]string{spiffeID.String()})
	if err != nil {
		return []byte{}, err
	}
	uriSANExtension := []pkix.Extension{{
		Id:       spiffe.OidExtensionSubjectAltName,
		Value:    uriSANs,
		Critical: true,
	}}

	csrData := &x509.CertificateRequest{
		Subject:            *a.Config.CertDN,
		SignatureAlgorithm: x509.ECDSAWithSHA256,
		ExtraExtensions:    uriSANExtension,
	}

	csr, err := x509.CreateCertificateRequest(rand.Reader, csrData, a.key)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE REQUEST", Bytes: csr}), nil
}

		return nil
	}
	return nil
}

	// These fields are the ones that need to be in the general hash; other things will be

	// Note that container settings are handled separately.

		}
	}

	return strings.Join(ports, ", ")
}
